title: Scaleway creation errors must retain the creating state
answers: Why does Cluster Autoscaler detect failed Scaleway node creation slowly?
How should Scaleway creation_error map to an instance status?
What state and error information should a failed Scaleway node creation report?
body:
Symptom: Cluster Autoscaler is slow to detect a Scaleway node that could not be created.
Root cause: cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/scaleway/scaleway_node_group.go:fromScwStatus populated creation-error details without explicitly setting InstanceCreating.
Fix pattern: Map NodeStatusCreationError to InstanceCreating while preserving ErrorInfo, including the creation_error code and failure message.
Constraints: This mapping applies to Scaleway creation failures; do not generalize it to other statuses. cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/scaleway/scaleway_node_group_test.go:TestFromScwStatus checks both the creating state and error information.
